description: The on-demand list price each cloud provider publishes to rent a GPU instance, read from the provider's own price feed (AWS Price List, us-east-1, one price list a month back to October 2020; Azure Retail Prices, eastus, with the date each price took effect). One line per provider and instance, never averaged. Each line gives the price per instance-hour as listed, the price per GPU-hour (derived: listed price divided by the GPUs on the provider's specification page), every price change, and the price history. Filter by GPU (for example H100), provider, instance or date range.

gpu.description: GPU family, for example H100, A100, H200, B200, B300 or GB200.

history.description: Include every price point in the window, not only the latest price and the changes.

instance.description: One instance type, for example p5.48xlarge or Standard_ND96isr_H100_v5.

provider.description: Cloud provider, for example AWS or Azure.

since.description: ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD. History from this date; the price holding on that date is included.

until.description: ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD. History up to this date.

name: compute_list_prices
title: GPU rental list prices
